```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
library(ggplot2) 
library(GGally) 
library(car)
library(dplyr)
library(DHARMa)
library(ggeffects)
library(purrr)

df1 <- read.csv("../data_derived/df_all_new.csv")

vars <- c(
  "road_national_dist",
  "road_resource_dist",
  "all_road_dist",
  "river_mout_dist",
  "fresh_lake_dist",
  "river_dist",
  "cabin_dist"
)

## Outliers - box/violin plots
plots <- vars %>%
  set_names() %>%
  map(~ ggplot(df1, aes(x = .data[[.x]])) +
        geom_histogram() +
        facet_grid(location ~ type) +
        labs(x = .x)
      )


if(!dir.exists("../figs/outliers"))dir.create("../figs/outliers")
folder <- "../figs/outliers/"
walk2(
  plots,
  names(plots),
  ~ ggsave(
    filename = paste0(folder, .y, ".png"),
    plot = .x,
    width = 8,
    height = 6
  )
)


## Outliers-Cleavland
plots_cl <- vars %>%
  set_names() %>%
  map(~ ggplot(df1, aes(x = .data[[.x]], y = seq_len(nrow(df1)),
               fill = location,
               colour = location
               )
      ) +
        geom_point() +
        facet_grid(location ~ type) +
        labs(x = .x,
             y = "ID")
  )

if(!dir.exists("../figs/outliers_cleavland"))dir.create("../figs/outliers_cleavland")
folder <- "../figs/outliers_cleavland/"
walk2(
  plots_cl,
  names(plots_cl),
  ~ ggsave(
    filename = paste0(folder, .y, ".png"),
    plot = .x,
    width = 8,
    height = 6
  )
)
```
